# ash_double_entry v1.0.17 - Table of Contents

A customizable double entry bookkeeping system backed by Ash resources.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Tutorials
  - [Get Started](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/getting-started-with-ash-double-entry.md)

- DSLs
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Account](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashdoubleentry-account.md)
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Balance](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashdoubleentry-balance.md)
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Transfer](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashdoubleentry-transfer.md)

- About AshDoubleEntry
  - [Change Log](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- Introspection
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Account.Info](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Account.Info.md): Introspection helpers for `AshDoubleEntry.Account`
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Balance.Info](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Balance.Info.md): Introspection helpers for `AshDoubleEntry.Balance`
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Transfer.Info](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Transfer.Info.md): Introspection helpers for `AshDoubleEntry.Transfer`

- Entities
  - [AshDoubleEntry.Account](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Account.md): An extension for creating a double entry ledger account. See the getting started guide for more.

  - [AshDoubleEntry.Balance](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Balance.md): An extension for creating a double entry ledger balance. See the getting started guide for more.

  - [AshDoubleEntry.Transfer](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.Transfer.md): An extension for creating a double entry ledger transfer. See the getting started guide for more.

- Types
  - [AshDoubleEntry.ULID](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/AshDoubleEntry.ULID.md): An Ash type for ULID strings.

## Mix Tasks

- AshDoubleEntry
  - [mix ash_double_entry.install](https://ash-double-entry.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshDoubleEntry.Install.md): Installs AshDoubleEntry
